name: skinflint
description: Short answers, minimal code and shorter tool output for Claude Code, with nothing to install: POSIX sh and awk on Linux and macOS, a self-built exe on Windows.

hooks.command:
{ true "\" <# "; } >/dev/null

case ${OSTYPE:-} in msys*|cygwin*) exec powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/win/run.ps1" activate ;; esac
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" activate
#> } > $null
